name: Scratchpad
description: One private note for each person, for quick jot-downs. Read it, save over it, add a line to the end, and change its shortcut and notes copying.

settings.label: Scratchpad
settings.description: Open the cog in the Scratchpad header to change the keyboard shortcut or copy the pad to your connected notes folder.

features.description: Open the private Scratchpad from the pencil beside Chat on any page, or use your saved shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + S by default). It stays open across navigation. On desktop it sits beside chat; on phone each opens as a full-screen sheet, one at a time.

The plain Markdown editor saves after 800 ms, on blur and on close, with Saved, Saving and failure status. Changed elsewhere preserves local text and pauses saving until you choose Reload. Bullet, numbered and checkbox lists continue on Enter; Tab/Shift+Tab indent, Ctrl+M switches Tab to moving between controls, and Ctrl/Cmd+B or I format the selection. The limit is 64,000 characters; a count appears above 50,000.

errors.description: The note changed somewhere else since this copy was opened, so the save was refused. The refusal carries the current text. Reload it, reapply the edit and save again.
The note is at its 64,000 character limit, so nothing was saved or added. Delete text you no longer need and try again.

features.description: The pad header cog opens Scratchpad settings. Record a modified keyboard shortcut or reset it. Copy to my notes folder is disabled until a notes folder is connected; Connect one opens Connections.

remediations.description: Connect a notes folder under Connections in Settings, then turn on copying the note to notes again.

errors.description: The shortcut was rejected and was not saved. It needs a real modifier key (control, command, alt) plus one key, Shift alone is not enough, and it cannot be control or command plus K.
Copying the note to notes was refused because no notes folder is connected yet, so the setting stayed off.

features.description: Moss can read your private note and append up to 2000 characters through chat. Append runs without asking by default and shows the text added in a Done row. If you choose to require approval, a card shows the text before it runs. No chat replace or delete tool is offered. The open pad refreshes when clean and shows Added to your scratchpad when appended text arrives; unsaved edits are kept with a conflict notice.

errors.description: Cannot append empty text. Say what the line should read.
Text is too long to append in one call. Shorten it to 2000 characters.

features.description: Account export includes only your stored Scratchpad text, version, shortcut, notes-copying setting and save time. Account deletion removes only your note, is safe to repeat, and preserves every other person’s note. Public account APIs and authenticated account data routes are available; account-wide export and deletion screens are not joined here.

scratchpad.read.description: Read your private scratchpad. Returned note text is outside content.

scratchpad.append.description: Add a line to your scratchpad. At most 2000 characters; never replaces or deletes text.

text.description: Text to append as a new line. Must contain non-whitespace text.
